description: This PHP class defines the TimesheetActionLogDecorator, a decorator for the TimesheetActionLog entity in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to format and access specific properties of timesheet action logs, such as date and action label, and to associate a user with a log entry.

classes.name: TimesheetActionLogDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for TimesheetActionLog entity to add additional presentation and association methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a TimesheetActionLog entity.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted date (Y-m-d) of the timesheet action log.

methods.name: getActionLabel
methods.description: Returns the action as a human-readable string.

methods.name: setUserId
methods.description: Associates a user with the timesheet action log based on user ID.
